# The bus driver waited for the walker

The driver saw Mum coming and waited. The timetable cannot capture that courtesy without turning it into an expectation that drivers absorb every delay. [[Care arrangements]]: a system works partly through discretionary help, which deserves recognition without becoming its only reliable mechanism. We still need the accessible route when a different driver is on duty.
